say:1:1630324101:1.text: Baa! You can't have someone who hates sheep be in charge of feeding sheep! That's just wrong!
say:1:1630324101:1.source_cn: 咩——让不喜欢咩的人来喂咩是不对的！
say:1:1630324101:1.male: Baa! You can't have someone who hates sheep be in charge of feeding sheep! That's just wrong!
say:1:1630324101:1.female: Baa! You can't have someone who hates sheep be in charge of feeding sheep! That's just wrong!

say:2:1630324102:1.text: Keep that man away from our pen! Every time he feeds us, it's the bare minimum!
say:2:1630324102:1.source_cn: 不要再让那个男人接近这里了，他每次喂的草都是最少的！
say:2:1630324102:1.male: Keep that man away from our pen! Every time he feeds us, it's the bare minimum!
say:2:1630324102:1.female: Keep that man away from our pen! Every time he feeds us, it's the bare minimum!

say:3:1630324103:1.text: He doesn't even like us! Always shooing us up the mountain when we're starving—he's tormenting us on purpose!
say:3:1630324103:1.source_cn: 他根本就不喜欢我们！他没事就把饥饿的我们赶到山上去，这...
say:3:1630324103:1.male: He doesn't even like us! Always shooing us up the mountain when we're starving—he's tormenting us on purpose!
say:3:1630324103:1.female: He doesn't even like us! Always shooing us up the mountain when we're starving—he's tormenting us on purpose!

say:4:1630324104:1.text: Only Cassadee ever truly cared about us. She always brought the freshest, crispiest grass.
say:4:1630324104:1.source_cn: 只有科丝蒂最喜欢我们——她每次都会带来很多新鲜的草喂我。
say:4:1630324104:1.male: Only Cassadee ever truly cared about us. She always brought the freshest, crispiest grass.
say:4:1630324104:1.female: Only Cassadee ever truly cared about us. She always brought the freshest, crispiest grass.

say:5:1630324105:1.text: But it's been so long since she last came... When will Cassadee come back...?
say:5:1630324105:1.source_cn: 可是她已经好久没来了。科丝蒂什么时候会再来啊……
say:5:1630324105:1.male: But it's been so long since she last came... When will Cassadee come back...?
say:5:1630324105:1.female: But it's been so long since she last came... When will Cassadee come back...?
